summary_rationale: International Gemological Institute Limited (renamed from International Gemmological Institute (India) Limited in May 2026) operates a capital-light, high-switching-cost certification tollbooth anchored in Surat and Mumbai (~75.7% of turnover) and unified globally across 36 labs, 21 schools, New York colored-stone pioneer AGL (Feb 2026), and wholly owned IGI Botswana (Sep 7, 2026). Core economics remain elite: 61.4% consolidated Q2 FY27 OPM, 89% H1 FY27 OCF/EBITDA (118% OCF/PAT), ₹1,074.9 Cr cash, zero bank debt, 69.2% ROCE, minimal ₹6.1 Cr contingent tax disputes (with the KS Trade LLC NY suit dismissed Dec 2025), and +31% YoY revenue growth aided by GIA's Oct 2025 LGD grading overhaul and India's FY26 LGD export crossover. KPI health remains PASS_WITH_WATCH to monitor B2B debtor days (66 days in FY26; ECL reduced to 1.82% prior to Q2 FY27's ₹662M release), India standalone EBITDA margin compression (-340 bps YoY to 69.5% on leadership/commission spend), indirect 10% U.S. Section 301 diamond tariff strain on Surat polishers, GCAL by Sarine's new SEEPZ Mumbai jewelry lab, and Blackstone's 76.55% MPS overhang alongside Note 47's sponsor-linked ESOP vesting (19.55M options, ~4.52% dilution).
